Audio Cutter

Cut a section out of any audio file in your browser. Set start and end times, preview the selection, then download it as an MP3.

Duration: —

Files never leave your device — decoding, cutting and MP3 encoding all happen in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose an audio file from your device and wait for its duration to load.
  2. Enter the start and end times in seconds for the section you want to keep.
  3. Optionally press Preview to listen to the selection before cutting.
  4. Click "Cut & Download MP3" to save the section as an MP3 file.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What format is the cut audio saved in?

The selected section is encoded to a real MP3 at 128 kbps using the lamejs encoder, entirely on your device.

Which audio formats can I cut?

Most common formats (MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A/AAC) decode in modern browsers. If decoding fails, your browser cannot read that file's audio.

Is my audio uploaded anywhere?

Yes — the cut MP3 is generated locally in your browser. Your file is never uploaded anywhere.
